'''Tey-Zuka''' was a [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Shortly after [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] [[Escape from the Spire|escape]] from the [[Spire (Stygeon)|Spire]] [[Prison/Legends|Prison]], Tey-Zuka was stationed on board a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] with the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The pair took the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]], where the Separatists [[Battle of Zanbar/Legends|attacked]] a [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] rendezvousing there with Maul. Tey-Zuka remained on the ship during the battle, in which both sides sustained heavy casualties and Maul escaped.<ref name="SOD1" />

In the aftermath of the battle of Zanbar, General Grievous and Tey-Zuka pursued Maul and his followers to the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where they again [[Battle on Ord Mantell/Legends|attacked]] the Shadow Collective. During the battle, Maul boarded the ''Providence''-class dreadnought he and Grievous were aboard, striking down Tey-Zuka and the rest of the battle droids on the bridge before capturing Grievous.<ref name="SOD2">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 2|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 2]]</ref>
